description: P32 (plan M6-M9 sections 2.10 and 5.11): a crewed siege catapult (scripts/world/siege_engine.gd). It fires only while crewed, turns at 20 degrees a second and lobs stones at a giant 40-180 m off, one every 9 s of crewed reloading; a circle on the ground shows where each stone comes down. Its fall costs every soldier within 30 m 20 morale. Its poise breaks to a heavy blow, and a stage-6 giant can seize it - staggered or without its crew - and hurl it.
